query.text: 生活助手，请帮我看着熨斗并陪我整理衣物，如果我离开时有安全隐患请提醒我。
query.text_en: Life assistant, please help me watch the iron and accompany me while I organize clothes, and remind me if there are any safety hazards when I leave.

annotation.text_zh: 熨斗还开着，请及时关闭，注意安全。
annotation.text_en: The iron is still on, please turn it off to be safe.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
